visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a light pink blazer and white top, looks into a vanity mirror adorned with bright round bulb lights. She holds a smartphone with a black and white patterned case in her right hand, capturing her reflection. The setting is a brightly lit, modern indoor lounge or dressing area with blurred white furniture in the distance. (2) The scene shifts to a grey-walled hallway where the woman stands while a female staff member in a black mask and shirt adjusts her blazer. The lighting is artificial and cool-toned. The woman holds her phone and looks towards someone off-camera. (3) The woman walks briskly into a professional news studio. The background features blue illuminated walls, a large 'mnews' logo, and television monitors displaying clock digits. The floor is black and reflective. (4) Inside the studio, at a grey desk, a staff member adjusts a lavalier microphone on the woman's blazer. Another woman in a white lace top sits next to her. The lighting is professional studio grade with soft, even distribution. (5) A wide shot reveals the studio environment with a large black robotic camera crane moving in the foreground. The woman and the anchor are seated at the 'mnews' news desk, preparing for a broadcast. (6) Close-up of the woman in the pink blazer speaking animatedly, gesturing with her hands. On a separate screen or inset stage, a man in a grey suit and brown pants performs sign language interpretation. (7) Final shots show the studio output on monitors, confirming the live nature of the broadcast with news tickers and graphic overlays.
